author: Grant Tosterud
title: Heavy rain possible in parts of New Mexico into the weekend - NewsBreak
text:
By Grant Tosterud ,
5 hours ago
Rain and thunderstorm chances will increase across New Mexico later this week and into the weekend. Heavy rain will be possible in northern New Mexico Friday.
More storms are moving through New Mexico Wednesday afternoon, mainly across western parts of the state and along the central mountain chain. A couple storms near Las Vegas and in northwest New Mexico have turned strong and severe, with gusty winds, small hail, lightning, and heavy rain the biggest threats. These storms will continue moving northward into this evening, with the chance for rain moving into the Rio Grande Valley. A few showers or storms are possible in the Metro again tonight, but it won’t be as active as the night before.
Parts of northern New Mexico and southern Colorado will wake up to a few spotty showers Thursday morning. More rain and storms will develop by the afternoon across the western half of New Mexico into southwest Colorado. A few spotty showers could make it as far east as Albuquerque late tomorrow evening again. Showers and storms will stick around northern New Mexico into Friday morning before even more storms develop again in the afternoon. Friday will be the most active day for northwest and northern New Mexico as heavy rain will be possible. A line of storms will likely develop Friday afternoon and move east across New Mexico into the overnight hours and early Saturday morning. This is what will bring the heaviest of the rain for many areas.
Showers and storms will return again Saturday afternoon to central, northern, and eastern parts of New Mexico with cooler high temperatures across the state. Drier weather returns statewide on Sunday though. Some forecast models bring back rain and thunderstorm chances early next week.
